scope: Read-only audit of current 11 authored facilities / 44 native directions; only these audit JSON/MD files written. No render/regeneration, source metadata, main assets, atlas or gameplay changes.
approval_authority: Dispatch explicitly states user accepted all satisfactory facilities and closed final visual/roof gate; coordinator must persist that acceptance. Historical candidate metadata is preserved by this audit.
projection_conclusion: No semantic wrong-camera defect found. Direct read-only opening of all 11 current blends proves ORTHO 192, Euler XYZ 60/0/45 (optical 30 degree elevation, game yaw 45), targetZ 1.8 tiles, native I=(16,8), J=(-16,8), Z=(0,-19.5959187). Raw raster 11 FAIL and 3 WARN remain unchanged, auxiliary for these specifically source-proven directions; this is not a blanket raster PASS or permission for an unknown source.
methods: Viewed all 11 native four-direction boards and final runtime 44-view board.
Opened every current facility.blend in Blender read-only without saving/rendering; extracted camera, hierarchy, visibility, selected group bounds and inventory.
Recomputed all source/image SHA-256 and compared current summary/rotation/runtime presentation lineage.
Compared current 44 native and 44 HD review images against existing independent-reopen renders and runtime copies; compared physical/color RGBA and alpha.
Read builder and authored review runner: rendering rotates only FacilityRoot at 0/90/180/270, fixed camera; compared all saved rotation matrices.
Existing positive calibration PASS and deliberately wrong-camera negative FAIL retained.
limitations: No fresh renders generated: reproducibility here independently compares existing reopen images plus direct current source inspection.
Raster peak-to-specific-mesh attribution is an inference from geometry/visuals, not per-edge semantic segmentation; exact source camera and analytic basis are directly measured.
No live Phaser placement, NPC integration or atlas/build certification; main import byte-equality remains pending coordinator write.
Native tiny cups, eggs, molds, grate bars and flowers collapse to accents; user acceptance covers reviewed appearance, not additional detail fidelity.
